name: Shirasaka Mio
source:
Class: 3-C

[url=/c19333]Taichi[/url] and [url=/c19338]Mei's[/url] older sister, a gentle, kind, and intelligent girl.
Mio has been holed up in her room for a while since an assailant violated her. However, after meeting [url=/c19347]Yuka[/url] on the Internet, she gradually recovers and proposes moving out of the loathsome city to her family.
After the move and joining a particular organization at Yuka's recommendation, she seems to have regained her lost happiness .....

[Translated and edited from [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=804105]Getchu[/url]]
